vault.extensions.cssOverridesDesc: Values are raw HSL channels applied to the document root in both modes. Disabled extensions keep their defaults.
vault.extensions.description: Every extension declares what it may touch — CSS variables, a panel or title-bar slot, a named save hook or the event stream. Nothing executes third-party code: handlers get a frozen sandbox, a failure stays inside its own plugin, and every run is logged below.
